name: Minami Mako
source:
"Do you have a request...? Don't get along with anyone other than me."

Kuro's classmate. She is in the art department. Ever since she saw her at the entrance ceremony, she has continued to admire Mashiro. She hopes for her to model for a painting someday, but doesn't have the courage to speak up - let alone say it out loud.

"If I was the one next to her..." Her thoughts grow stronger day by day, and eventually...

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_mako.png]official website[/url]]
